data.label: include
data.reason_zh: 摘要明确描述八类可复用工件的版本化修改、与评估关联，并在后续任务中保留能力，符合方法类 RSI。

scope_support.feedback_quote: Turning task experience into reusable capability requires connecting the changed component to its evaluation and subsequent use.
scope_support.object_quote: Eight entity families expose reusable operations, methods, agents, control flow, interfaces, and supporting state to revision through a common versioned lifecycle.
scope_support.persistence_quote: The cases show retained capabilities entering later website, game, and research work, while also documenting incomplete objectives and an unsuccessful strategy.
